title: Balloon + Bubble + Star Popping Game + Presets + Editable
description: A review activity for grades 1–6. Follow these simple steps to use it with your class.
steps: Log in with an active Premium account.
Choose Balloon, Bubble, or Star mode.
Select a preset or add your own words and pictures.
Choose the players, time, speed, and sound settings.
Start the game and pop the items to practice reading.
Export your edited sets for use on another device.
